title: Gas Price Without Guard
summary: ENGINE BUG. With no transaction guard and gasPrice != 0, Safe 1.5.0 refunds gas from the Safe to tx.origin after the call (Safe.sol 196-198, handlePayment 229-230); with no ETH the refund fails and the whole transaction reverts GS011, nonce unused.
lesson: Found by differential fuzzing; expectations are the on-chain outcome. Engine: ok, nonce used (it only models safeTxGas, simulate.ts swallow).

steps.label: gasPrice 1, no ETH in the Safe: the gas refund fails, GS011
